name: HatchGrab
subtitle: Orders and kitchen for food trucks
promotionalText: Take orders in advance, protect the kitchen from an overload of orders and keep serving even when reception drops. The ordering app for food truck teams.
description:
HatchGrab is the ordering and kitchen app for food trucks: the tool with which your team runs service.

Customers order in advance and choose a pickup time. Your team sees all orders on one screen, approves what the kitchen can make, and then marks each order as ready and as collected.

■ Don’t promise a time you won’t meet
Set how much your kitchen can make at once and how long it takes. When a pickup time fills up, customers can’t choose it, so the queue matches the kitchen’s pace.

■ Take orders on the spot
Add orders taken by the food truck to the same screen as the advance orders, so the kitchen works from one queue.

■ One screen for the kitchen
The kitchen screen shows what to make now, what is next in line and what is ready, and alerts you when an order needs to be started.

■ Printing order slips (“bons”)
Connect a receipt printer in the kitchen via Bluetooth or via the local network, and the slips print automatically.

■ Keep serving even when reception drops
Switch on offline-mode protection: if the connection drops, advance orders are paused, so nobody places an order you won’t see. Orders you take on the device are saved and sync when the connection returns.

■ Built for working in a food truck
Use it on iPhone or on iPad. Leave the screen on during service, get an alert when an order is waiting for approval, and lock the app with Face ID or Touch ID.

■ Plan the week
Set up your events and locations once and take orders for each of them.

HatchGrab is intended for food truck operators and their teams. Signing in requires a HatchGrab account.
